title: Munnar Tea Hills & Mist Escape
summary: Explore rolling tea estates, misty viewpoints, and cool highland trails in the lap of the Western Ghats.

itinerary.title: Arrival & Tea Estate Walk
itinerary.description: Check in to your hillside resort. Evening guided walk through the aromatic tea estates with sunset views.

itinerary.title: Viewpoints & Museum
itinerary.description: Visit Eravikulam National Park, explore the Tea Museum, and witness the mesmerizing Attukal Waterfalls.

itinerary.title: Leisure & Departure
itinerary.description: Morning at Mattupetty Dam. Post-breakfast departure with memories to cherish forever.

title: Alleppey Backwater Bliss
summary: Drift through emerald canals on a luxury houseboat, surrounded by swaying palms and serene village life.

itinerary.title: Arrival & Houseboat Check-in
itinerary.description: Board your private houseboat in the afternoon. Enjoy a sunset cruise through the tranquil backwaters.

itinerary.title: Village Life & Canals
itinerary.description: Morning kayaking at sunrise. Visit local coir weaving villages and enjoy a traditional Kerala thali lunch.

itinerary.title: Kumarakom Bird Sanctuary
itinerary.description: Early morning birdwatching at the famous sanctuary. Afternoon cooking class — learn to make Kerala prawn curry.

itinerary.title: Leisure & Departure
itinerary.description: Final morning cruise before check-out. Transfer to Cochin airport or railway station.

title: Royal Rajasthan Heritage Trail
summary: Walk through golden forts, blue-painted havelis, and vibrant bazaars of royal Rajasthan.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Jaipur – Pink City
itinerary.description: Check in to heritage hotel. Evening walk through Johari Bazaar and visit Hawa Mahal at dusk.

itinerary.title: Forts & Palaces
itinerary.description: Full-day tour of Amber Fort, City Palace, and Jantar Mantar. Witness the grand light & sound show.

itinerary.title: Jaipur to Jodhpur
itinerary.description: Drive to the Blue City. Check in and explore Mehrangarh Fort's towering ramparts.

itinerary.title: Blue City Walk
itinerary.description: Guided walking tour through cobalt blue lanes, ancient step wells, and the vibrant Sardar Market.

itinerary.title: Camel Safari & Cultural Evening
itinerary.description: Sunset camel safari in the dunes. Traditional folk music and Rajasthani dinner under the stars.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Post-breakfast check-out and transfer to Jodhpur airport.

title: Andaman Island Adventure
summary: Dive into crystal-clear waters, trek through rainforests, and discover pristine coral reefs in the Andaman Sea.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Port Blair
itinerary.description: Check in and visit the historic Cellular Jail. Attend the moving light & sound show in the evening.

itinerary.title: Port Blair to Havelock Island
itinerary.description: Ferry to Havelock Island. Check in to beachside resort. Afternoon at Neil's Cove.

itinerary.title: Scuba Diving & Snorkeling
itinerary.description: Morning scuba diving at Elephant Beach (beginner-friendly). Afternoon snorkeling and glass-bottom boat ride.

itinerary.title: Radhanagar Beach
itinerary.description: Full day at Radhanagar Beach — consistently ranked Asia's best beach. Sunset photography session.

itinerary.title: Return & Departure
itinerary.description: Morning ferry back to Port Blair. Shopping at Aberdeen Bazaar before departure.

title: Coorg Coffee Trail & Waterfalls
summary: Breathe in the aroma of freshly brewed coffee, trek to misty waterfalls, and unwind in a lush green sanctuary.

itinerary.title: Arrival & Plantation Tour
itinerary.description: Check in to a coffee estate homestay. Evening guided tour of the coffee plantation with a coffee tasting session.

itinerary.title: Waterfalls & Elephant Camp
itinerary.description: Trek to Abbey Falls. Afternoon visit to Dubare Elephant Camp for elephant bathing experience.

itinerary.title: Raja's Seat & Departure
itinerary.description: Sunrise at Raja's Seat. Post-breakfast check-out and departure.

title: Varanasi – Soul of India
summary: Witness the eternal rhythm of life and death at the ghats of the holy Ganges, the world's oldest living city.

itinerary.title: Arrival & Ganga Aarti
itinerary.description: Check in to heritage guesthouse. Evening Ganga Aarti ceremony — a mesmerizing spiritual spectacle.

itinerary.title: Ghats & Old City
itinerary.description: Pre-dawn boat ride on the Ganges. Walk through the narrow lanes of Vishwanath Gali and explore the old city.

itinerary.title: Sarnath – Buddha's First Sermon
itinerary.description: Day trip to Sarnath — the birthplace of Buddhism. Visit the Dhamek Stupa and Archaeological Museum.

itinerary.title: Silk Weaving & Departure
itinerary.description: Visit a traditional Banarasi silk weaving workshop. Post-lunch check-out and departure.

title: Manali Snow & Adventure Rush
summary: Race down snowy slopes, river-raft through gorges, and camp under a billion stars in the Himalayan heights.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Manali
itinerary.description: Settle into your mountain chalet. Evening stroll through the Mall Road and Hadimba Temple area.

itinerary.title: Rohtang Pass
itinerary.description: Full-day excursion to Rohtang Pass (subject to permit availability). Snow activities, photography, and hot chai.

itinerary.title: River Rafting & Solang Valley
itinerary.description: Morning river rafting on the Beas. Afternoon at Solang Valley — zip-line and paragliding.

itinerary.title: Old Manali & Vashisht Springs
itinerary.description: Explore Old Manali's bohemian cafés. Relax at the natural hot springs in Vashisht village.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Post-breakfast check-out. Transfer to Kullu airport or Manali bus stand.

title: Goa – Sun, Sand & Spice
summary: From Anjuna's nightlife to Palolem's serenity — soak in the golden beaches, Portuguese heritage, and fiery Goan cuisine.

itinerary.title: Arrival & North Goa
itinerary.description: Check in to beachside villa. Evening at Calangute and Baga beaches. Sunset drinks at a cliff-top shack.

itinerary.title: Dudhsagar & Spice Farm
itinerary.description: Full-day jeep safari to Dudhsagar Falls. Visit an organic spice plantation for a farm-to-table lunch.

itinerary.title: Old Goa Heritage & South Goa
itinerary.description: Morning tour of Basilica of Bom Jesus and Sé Cathedral. Drive to South Goa's peaceful Palolem Beach.

itinerary.title: Palolem Kayaking & Departure
itinerary.description: Sunrise kayaking at Palolem. Post-breakfast check-out and departure.
